findings.note: The shipped CHANGELOG entry declares that TWO changes were found uncovered by any fixture, and names only the journal-delete-ordering change (mutant C) and the nonce/batch-binding change (mutant D). The shipped state has THREE: mutation-proofs.log labels C, D and F UNCOVERED, the T-007 contract comment says C, D and F, and the implementation report round-13 entry says that is now the third such hardening on this path. The CHANGELOG also carries no mention at all of the round-13 change it is describing bytes for (the split of the Block writer into a reporting form returning exit code plus a wrote-evidence flag, and the two-condition journal-discard guard on both post-publication branches), even though that is a behaviour change on this task's only live-write path. This is an under-disclosure of a self-declared regression-net gap on a Security-Sensitive publication surface, inside the artifact the Done When Governance bullet makes a deliverable, and it is the same amendment-propagation class the report itself records having hit twelve times in this package.

No clean full-suite green run at the shipped bytes is verifiable from this bundle. (1) The report's canonical Test Result field declares PASS 306 passed / 0 failed and its GREEN capture section names green-sh.log and green-ps1.log, both of which do carry RESULT 306 passed, 0 failed in this bundle. The shipped tally is 361/0 (green-shipped-sh.log, green-shipped-ps1.log, and the two focused-tests logs the contract declares as green evidence), and the contract states the tally is 361/0. The report's own round-9 entry says the captures are now uniformly green-shipped, yet the Test Evidence section was never repointed, so the report's headline verification claim is wrong for the code being shipped by 55 assertions. Round 12 of this same package treated a one-assertion version of this exact discrepancy in the contract as a Major. (2) mutation-proofs.log states the UNCOVERED verdicts for mutants C, D and F relative to the clean control run at the top of this log, but the log contains no control run: it opens directly at MUTANT A with RESULT 360 passed, 1 failed. The three UNCOVERED determinations, which are the central residual-risk disclosure of this task, therefore cannot be confirmed from the artifact that asserts them, and the only full-suite runs in that log that reach 361/0 are runs against MUTATED code, not against the shipped resolver whose sha256 the log restores at the end (379c3ed0...).

Stale relative to the quality-gate regression capture. The table records the block suite at 306/306 and the discovery suite at 12/12; the carried regression log shows 24 for discovery and the block suite at 361. The table also omits four suites the contract and the regression log show were run at the shipped state (validate-resolver-evidence 138, parity 70, metamorphic 150, component-path-resolver 73). The gate evidence itself is complete and green, so this is presentation only.

Still cites green-panel8-sh.log and green-panel8-ps1.log as two of the three new declared rows. Neither file appears in the report's own Outputs table nor anywhere in this bundle; round 9 renamed those captures to green-shipped. Same cited-file-does-not-exist class the round-12 entry records finding on the contract.

The four-mutant table (bare-unlink-rollback, no-journal-before-rename, no-post-publication-recheck, digest-only-step13, control 46 passed / 0 failed) describes a run whose log is not a declared output and is not carried in this bundle; the only mutation artifact carried is the six-mutant A-F set, which does not include the bare-unlink mutant. Quality Gate Focus item 3 names mutation (a) as the non-vacuity proof for this task's load-bearing rollback assertions, so that specific proof is unverifiable here. Substance is unaffected: the assertions compare against PRE byte literals and a missing target is reported as a MISSING sentinel, so the unlink-versus-restore discrimination is directly inspectable in the driver.
